warnings: This is a biostimulant study (actosol + yeast extract), not a CO2 study - wrong meta-analysis context
Complex factorial design with 12 treatments (3 actosol × 4 yeast levels) - each needs individual extraction
Multiple outcome variables in same tables - focus only on fresh yield data
Units vary between kg/fad (faddan) which needs conversion to standard units
Essential oil data is secondary outcome, not primary yield
Two growing seasons reported - treat as separate experiments or average
LSD values provided for statistical comparison

WARNING: VAR-UNCLEAR - Variance type not clearly stated
recon.variance_source: L.S.D values provided in tables, e.g. 'L.S.D 67.64' for fresh herb yield
recon.control_definition: T1: 0 cm3/L actosol plus 0 g/l yeast extract (no biostimulant)
recon.treatment_definition: Various combinations of actosol (10, 20 cm3/L) and yeast extract (5, 10, 15 g/L)
recon.potential_tc_confusion: Multiple treatments vs single control - need to extract each treatment vs T1
recon.sample_size_source: There were three replicates for each treatment
recon.extraction_guidance: Extract fresh herb yield data from Table 3 only. Control is T1 (0,0). Extract T2-T12 vs T1 separately. Convert kg/fad to kg/ha (1 fad = 4200 m² = 0.42 ha). Use LSD as variance measure. Consider seasons 1 and 2 as separate experiments or average them. Focus on fresh yield as primary outcome, ignore essential oil data.
